topics.name: DWH Sync Watermark and Cursor
topics.purpose: Define synchronization position using explicit source revision/watermark/cursor evidence, never local wall-clock or file modification time as source-of-truth ordering.

semantics.source_rule: Sync position is defined in the authoritative source's declared ordering/profile.
semantics.cursor_rule: Cursor/watermark identity is synchronization state, not record semantic identity.
semantics.time_rule: Wall-clock timestamps may be metadata but never authoritative ordering unless the source profile explicitly defines them so.
semantics.persist_rule: Last accepted sync position is persisted explicitly.
semantics.resume_rule: Resume starts from exact accepted watermark/cursor evidence.
semantics.gap_rule: Detected missing/gapped sequence hard-fails or triggers explicit resync policy.
semantics.reset_rule: Cursor reset/full resync is an explicit operation with provenance.

invariants.rule: Replica/sync state, transport position or local copy never replaces the semantic identity or ownership of the authoritative source data; propagation is explicit, provenance-bearing and conflict-aware.

references.purpose: Sync position may bind to exact revisions.

prose.summary: Define synchronization position using explicit source revision/watermark/cursor evidence, never local wall-clock or file modification time as source-of-truth ordering.
